name: Summer Tales
detailed_description:
What if everyone wore swimsuits... and no one thought it was strange—except you?

You wake up one morning to find your mother wearing a bikini in the living room.
No one else finds it odd. In fact, the entire world seems to have shifted.
Everyone is female. Everyone is dressed like it’s beach day.
And you're the only one who remembers things used to be... normal.

Welcome to a surreal visual novel where reality unravels one pong match at a time.

Talk to your friends, face strangely intimate challenges, and try to survive a world where the rules have changed—but no one else knows it.
Unless you uncover the truth, you might lose your grip on who you are... or what the world used to be.

🩷 Features

  • 🧠 A story-driven visual novel filled with mystery, swimsuits, and psychological twists

  • 🏓 Pong-inspired game system that changes the flow of the narrative

  • 💬 Branching dialogues and emotional choices

  • 👙 Everyone’s wearing a swimsuit—deal with it

  • 🎭 A unique blend of comedy, fantasy, and mystery

⚠️ Note: This Early Access version includes a preview of the adult content planned for the full release.
While the adult content is not fully implemented, this build demonstrates the intended tone and direction.
Mature scenes are planned to appear near the end of each character's route as part of the emotional and narrative climax.
Future updates will expand upon these elements. Player discretion is advised (18+).

🚧 This game is currently in Early Access. Only 3 stages (Chapters 2, 3, and 4) are available for now. The full release is planned for later in 2027!

💬 Chapter 1 is a secret and will be revealed when Early Access ends.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is intended for mature audiences (18+) due to planned future updates that may contain partial nudity, suggestive dialogue, and romantic or intimate themes.

Currently, this Early Access version does not contain any adult-only or sexually explicit content.

There are no depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual sex, extreme violence, drug/alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
